config.label: Base URL of the n8n instance
config.description: Base URL of the n8n instance. Defaults to http://localhost:5678.

config.label: n8n Public API key
config.description: n8n Public API key. Required for the execution and workflow checks.

config.label: Path to the n8n database
config.description: Path to the n8n database.sqlite file. Required for datastore checks on SQLite.

config.label: Postgres connection string
config.description: Postgres connection string. Takes precedence over N8N_SQLITE_PATH.

config.label: Checkout holding exported workflow JSON
config.description: Checkout holding exported workflow JSON. Required for the git drift check.

config.label: Minutes a run may stay in `running` before it counts as stuck
config.description: Minutes a run may stay in `running` before it counts as stuck. Defaults to 15.

config.label: Datastore warning threshold in bytes
config.description: Datastore warning threshold in bytes. Defaults to 1073741824 (1 GB).

config.label: Datastore critical threshold in bytes
config.description: Datastore critical threshold in bytes. Defaults to 4294967296 (4 GB).

config.label: Per-request API timeout in milliseconds
config.description: Per-request API timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000.
